Application Process

1

Create an Account

Sign up for our application portal to begin your application process.

2

Complete Your Profile

Fill in your personal information, educational background, and contact details.

3

Upload all necessary documentation based on your applicant type.

4

Pay Application Fee

Complete payment of the non-refundable application processing fee.

5

Track Your Application

Monitor your application status through your applicant portal.
